rationale.edition: The complete file list spans both codebases: OSS paths (`src/`, `web/src/`, `scripts/`) plus enterprise-owned paths under `o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/` (cloud table migration, `common/config.rs`, `metering/common.rs`, `metering/synthetics_grants.rs`). The feature is implemented in the OSS core/trial-quota and frontend, with the enterprise layer contributing the cloud-only DB migration, the `synthetics_free_status_step_pool` config knob, and the metering/grant accounting, so edition is `both`.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff is not docs-only/CI-only and has a real user-facing change (OrganizationManagement.vue). Neither the trigger comment nor any `tests-added` label is present, so there is no explicit opt-out.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change adds a user-facing UI flow in `web/src/components/settings/OrganizationManagement.vue`: two new columns (`status_steps_used`, `status_steps_total`) and a new `synthetics_status_protocol` tab in the per-org usage-limits dialog, with its own input label, title and subtitle wording. An admin can now view and set the new monthly status-steps grant, which is an interaction worth verifying.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change is in the settings-area Organization Management page. There is no dedicated Settings/Organizations folder under `tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/`, and sibling admin/settings specs (e.g. `logoManagement.spec.js`, `languageTranslation.spec.js`) live in GeneralTests, so GeneralTests is the closest fit.
rationale.group: `GeneralTests` is the matrix shard (ci-matrix) whose `run_files` already carries the admin/settings-adjacent specs this new organization-management spec should join.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is `web/src/components/settings/OrganizationManagement.spec.ts`, which is a Vitest unit test (not a Playwright spec under `tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/`), so there is no existing Playwright E2E coverage to enhance.
